$comment: Tool layer of reviewNoVerdictRetry (scripts/conveyor/review-referral-hold.mjs#resolveNoVerdictRetry): standard 0 → platform → this file → env WE_REVIEW_NO_VERDICT_COOLDOWN_RELEASES, source logged by policy-cascade. cooldownReleases = bounded cool-down releases (1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, 8h, 8h) for a head whose review verdict never landed, after the 2 immediate re-runs; integer 0..6, anything else is ignored. After the last release the hold is permanent (until a push or re-arm) and one needs-you event is raised per PR+head. Operator 2026-10-20.
